parsed.n_justification: To systematically evaluate runoff/recharge partitioning across the clay content gradient (5-55%), we use 11 columns with clay percentages at 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, and 55%.
